mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_security (member_id, login_fail_count) VALUES (#{memberId}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE member_security SET is_locked = 1, locked_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member_security SET login_fail_count = 0, is_locked = 0, locked_at = NULL WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL( (SELECT is_locked FROM member_security WHERE member_id = #{memberId}), 0 )
SELECT IFNULL( (SELECT login_fail_count FROM member_security WHERE member_id = #{memberId}), 0 )
